description: This file declares the OCIContainerImplementation class, which implements container management functionalities such as starting, stopping, and querying containers, as well as handling container events. It also defines an internal Job class for dispatching asynchronous tasks related to container events.

classes.name: OCIContainerImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing container lifecycle management and event handling for OCI containers, including methods for starting, stopping, and querying containers, as well as event notification mechanisms.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: An internal class representing a dispatchable job for container event handling, supporting asynchronous execution of container-related tasks.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Internal method to dispatch container events to registered notifications.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Method to trigger event dispatching based on event type and parameters.
